Transport management system (TMS) for logistics

Orders, trucks, drivers and documents in one system, cargo tracked from Uzbekistan to Kazakhstan, Russia or China, and the profit of every trip visible. An MVP in 10–14 weeks, from UZS 215 mln; the full version in 20–36 weeks.

What you get

What the MVP includes

  • Client portal

  • E-invoices

  • One person who makes the decisions
